about.what: Virtual demo visitors against a local FitWitness API (scripts/load-test.py), 2026-10-25. Each visitor opens a workspace, lists documents, loads one PNG and runs the default check twice, polling once a second like web/src/main.tsx. Steps of 1, 10, 25, 50, 100, 150 visitors, arrivals spread over 10 s, hourly admission buckets emptied before each step, one X-Forwarded-For address per visitor.
about.server: render.yaml start command on one machine: scripts/setup.py, then one uvicorn process (dispatcher inside) with the rules provider; PostgreSQL 16.2 from pgserver on the same machine, a new database per profile. environment.server_health.sha is the server's commit (0a42db8 before the dispatcher change, 9352146 after).
about.limits: One machine (4 CPUs, 15.7 GiB), database on the same machine, rules provider (no model latency), synthetic visitors doing the same thing; not the Render free instance (512 MB, shared CPU) and its remote database. One recording per profile.
